title_en: Wonders of Chinese Engineering (10/20): The Qinghai–Tibet Railway
note_en: 随着…而… ties a change to the thing that causes it: 防止铁轨随着土地的融化和冻结而变形 "keep the rails from warping as the ground thaws and freezes." 随着 introduces the changing condition and 而 links it to the result verb, roughly like English "as… so…"; in this formal written style the pair can't simply be dropped the way English might just say "from the thawing." The same pattern returns later as 随季节融化和冻结而变形.

sentences.en: At this point Hannah closed her laptop and thought: to protect the Tibetan antelope, more than thirty wildlife migration passages were built along the railway, and on the least stable permafrost, engineers used active cooling, just like the oil pipeline back home in Alaska. And that Alaska pipeline, too, is raised up high in some places so that caribou can migrate freely. She couldn't help thinking that building a route across wild, frozen land always comes down to the same two things: keeping the ground from thawing, and not blocking the animals that lived there long before any road.
